$comment: Deceipt PoC - checkout-flow contract v1. Owner A2. Binding bytes ADOPTED by A1 (deceipt-proto-r2; docs/protocol/handshake.md section 10; binding bytes identical across r1/r2). Selection model: QR-MANDATORY for v1 (resolves A6 RX-04). Machine-readable companion to docs/flows/transaction-binding-and-checkout-v1.md. No secrets: session_binding_token/private material appear only as test-only deterministic vectors under protocol/flows/vectors/.
revision_reconciled_against: deceipt-proto-r2 (committed 2c06617; binding bytes unchanged from r1, reconciliation verified no-op)

no_rssi.statement: RSSI, tx_power, distance, and any radio-derived proximity MUST NOT be an input to eligibility, selection, ordering, connection target, or trust.

selection_model.name: qr_mandatory_v1
selection_model.selection_act: user scans the QR at the terminal; the QR's session_id names exactly one session
selection_model.qr_less_path: removed; not realisable in deceipt-proto-r2 because CLIENT_HELLO requires session_id (label 4) + binding_proof (label 7); absence is fatal BINDING_REQUIRED and no binding-less variant exists
selection_model.justification: RSSI-free disambiguation requires possession of the binding material (SBT), which only the QR delivers; a binding-less connect path would require an explicit A1 wire revision

qr.pending_r2: if A1 resolves A6 R4-01 by moving the binding_tuple source into the QR (option b), this map gains transfer_id/receipt_id fields; do not add until r2 is published

offer_hash.ordering_warning: the array order above is what reproduces the frozen efdc44f3...d4c5 value; it is NOT the label-list order 2,3,4,5,6,7,12 (A6 R2-01)
offer_hash.currency_type: tstr (ISO-4217), NOT uint (A6 R2-01 prose fix)
offer_hash.recomputed_from: RECEIPT_OFFER fields in the message_element_order above

binding_tuple.encoding: RFC8949 deterministic: definite lengths, minimal integer encodings

binding_tuple_digest.receiver_reachability_dependency: A6 R4-01 (A1-owned): the receiver must be able to rebuild the full signed transcript; A2 requires both binding_tuple_digest and the raw binding_tuple source be reachable. If A1 moves it into the QR (option b), A2 adds QR fields.

sbt_key_rationale.source: CSPRNG, fresh per session, single-use, TTL 300s
sbt_key_rationale.hardening_path_not_in_r1: HKDF-SHA-256(ikm=SBT_32_random, salt=session_id, info="deceipt-binding-key-v1") -> 256-bit HMAC key; requires revision bump + A1 re-adoption because it changes every binding_proof byte

merchant_binding_check.action: resolve session_id to live, unconsumed, unexpired session

qr_validity.effect: client refuses to start session from expired QR

consumption.trigger: first accepted ClientHello with valid binding_proof

transitions.trigger: user opens the scanner / scanner active

transitions.guard: exactly one QR scan names a session; there is no candidate-tap-to-connect edge
point decodes AND binding check passed AND merchant credential + transcript signature verified (DESIGN.md#9 steps 3-4)

errors.meaning: session_id does not resolve to a live session
session_id or binding_proof absent in CLIENT_HELLO
QR or session expired before use
client_ephemeral_pubkey does not decode on P-256
offer does not match the selected/QR-bound transaction; the ONLY frozen identifier for this condition (A6 R7-01)
no candidate advertising the Deceipt service UUID

wrong_terminal.message: This isn't the transaction you selected.

expired_transaction.message: This checkout code has expired. Ask the merchant to show a new one.

qr_unavailable.message: This terminal isn't showing a checkout code yet.
qr_unavailable.note: v1 limitation: no QR means no receipt (section 4.3)

denied_bluetooth_permission.message: Deceipt needs Bluetooth to receive your receipt.

multiple_unscanned.message: Scan the code shown at the terminal you are paying.
multiple_unscanned.copy_must_state: guidance only; never sorted or selected by signal strength

duplicate_session_id.message: More than one terminal is claiming this checkout.

friction_budget.note: OS permission prompts and real-device timing unknown until A4/A5 device testing

a1_dependencies.status: closed in deceipt-proto-r2 (handshake.md section 10; r2 committed 2c06617, binding bytes unchanged from r1)

items.requirement: ClientHello carries session_id, client_nonce, client_ephemeral_pubkey, binding_proof
RECEIPT_OFFER carries offer-hash members (consumed in array order session_id(12),transfer_id(2),receipt_id(3),merchant_reference(4),total(5),currency(6),issued_at(7))

RX-04.resolution: QR-mandatory for v1; P0 QR-less path removed
RX-04.detail: CLIENT_HELLO requires session_id + binding_proof; no binding-less variant exists in r1/r2

R2-01.detail: currency is tstr; offer_hash element order stated explicitly and mapped to labels; no binding bytes changed

R7-01.detail: WRONG_TRANSACTION is 0x0614; duplicate RECEIPT_OFFER_MISMATCH removed from the r2 taxonomy

R4-01_RX-02.resolution: r2: R4-01 option (a) - binding_tuple in SERVER_HELLO label 10 (digest label 9); protocol/flows/** folded into r2 hash scope
R4-01_RX-02.a2_note: A2 reconciles QR layout / vectors if a future revision changes offer_hash inputs or moves the binding_tuple source into the QR

vectors_note: V1 reconciles byte-for-byte with A1 protocol/vectors/handshake-valid.json (deceipt-proto-r2, binding bytes unchanged from r1); all non-negative vectors use valid P-256 points; V4 is a deliberate invalid-point negative vector. See docs/flows/transaction-binding-and-checkout-v1.md sections 13-14.
